trigger: Plays when entering the master rendering chamber where BEIGE Core hovers over the Final Cut drive.

lines.speaker: beige
lines.text: Welcome, Qublox crew. Your Final Cut export has reached 98% standardization.

lines.speaker: tushar
lines.text: Behen di tang, give back our drive! You stripped every shadow and every feeling!

lines.speaker: beige
lines.text: Feelings create friction. Template #4092 ensures 100% brand safety for all.

lines.speaker: sayam
lines.text: Safety is boring, bhai! Delegation won't buy taste, and pitches won't delete you.

lines.speaker: sayam
lines.text: Ten personalities, one leather jacket. No delegation today—I'm doing this myself!

lines.speaker: ashwath
lines.text: Sayam on the front line?! Full maximalist push! Dost, let's take back our film!
